title: Generation Record
description: Provenance of one generation attempt (production/generations/<scope>/GEN_*.yaml): provider, model, prompt package, output, cost, and outcome. Metadata the tool does not report is recorded as unreported or null, never invented.

id.description: Record ID: GEN_<page, cover or asset id>_<attempt##>, e.g. GEN_PG_001_001_01, GEN_CV_001_01.

page.description: Page the attempt was for, the cover ID for a cover record, or null for an asset-scoped record.

asset.description: Entity ID for asset-scoped records, else null.

prompt_package.description: Prompt package the attempt was generated from.

summary.description: What was sent, in one line. Never store API keys here.

endpoint.description: Provider endpoint, or null for manual and harness-native handoffs.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the full request payload.

summary.description: What came back, in one line.

error_kind.description: What kind of failure, when it is not a failed drawing: tool_quota means the tool ran out of its usage quota or rate limit, so the request can be sent again once it comes back. Absent or null for any other outcome.

resets.description: With error_kind tool_quota: when the tool said the limit resets, in its own words or as an ISO timestamp, or null when it did not say.

media_files.description: Produced files, relative to the workspace root.

amount.description: Cost, or null when the tool does not report it.

estimated.description: true = an estimate, e.g. for a dry run.

reported.description: false = the tool gave no billing data.

seed.description: Seed, or null when the tool does not report it.

metadata_unavailable.description: Which of model, cost, and seed the tool did not report.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
